guide.title: How it works
guide.subtitle: Prices in other currencies from one base price, at a rate you control.

what.title: What it does
what.text: You enter prices in the base currency (e.g. PLN). "Fill prices" works out the other currencies of the store under the rules in Settings and saves them after you check a preview. The plugin never changes prices on its own.

where.title: Where
where.text:
On a product page: the "Prices in currencies" card beside the variants, with "Fill from PLN" for all variants.
On a collection or category page: a button for all of its products (a category includes subcategories).
Here, in "Fill prices": any products, a collection or a category.
Medusa's product list has no place for bulk actions, so several products are filled here.

rates.title: Rates
rates.text: NBP table A (average rates) is fetched once and kept until the next table is due (the next working day after noon). The table number and date are shown with every rate. Other currencies are converted through PLN (cross rate). If NBP does not answer, the last saved table can be used after you confirm it; it is marked with its date.

rounding.title: Margin and rounding
rounding.text: A margin raises the converted price by a percentage (a minus lowers it). Rounding is the last step: to the cent, to whole units, to ,99, to ,49 or ,99, or to full 5 or 10, always to the nearest allowed price.

tax.title: VAT
tax.text: Medusa marks each currency's (and region's) prices as gross or net. When both are gross and VAT differs (PL 23 %, DE 19 %), "Gross 1:1" keeps the gross amount and the net price changes; "Through net" takes the base VAT off, converts, and adds the target VAT. Gross base and net target always take the VAT off.

preview.title: Preview and save
preview.text: The preview lists every price: base price, currency, rate with its date, margin, new price, current price and what happens (add, overwrite, skip with the reason). Only empty prices are filled unless you choose to overwrite, which you confirm. The save writes exactly the preview: if a base price or the rate changed since, nothing is saved and the preview is refreshed.

origin.title: Where a price came from
origin.text: Every price written is recorded. A price still at the written amount shows "filled on … at …"; a price changed since, or never filled, shows "manual". The history lists every save with who, when, the rates and the counts.

events.title: For other plugins
events.text: Each save emits currency.prices_filled with every price written and the rates. A plugin that tracks price history (e.g. Omnibus in Compliance) can treat these changes as exchange-rate changes, not promotions.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.text: With the demo option, sample rates and sample products show the whole flow. NBP is not asked and prices are not written.

limits.title: Limits
limits.text: Prices with rules other than region (e.g. customer groups) are not touched. A fill covers at most the maxVariants option of variants. Rates are not updated automatically yet.

suggest.title: Price suggestions from exchange rates
suggest.hint: For every row the other prices are computed from the price typed last (or the {{base}} price), with the rates, margins, rounding and VAT set on the Currencies page.
